title: New hire immersion — week 1 check-in (Jun 09 2025)
content:
Context:
This is a semi-structured check-in for our new junior infra engineer (Samira) after their first week on the engineering org. Doc is meant for the DX team + Samira's buddy + hiring manager to capture a lightweight pulse, outstanding blockers, and concrete next steps.

Attendees (quick):
- Samira (new hire) — joined June 2
- Leo Chen — buddy (serving-runtime)
- Maya Patel — hiring manager (infra team)
- Ava Martinez — DX lead (author)
- Carter Nguyen — mentor (floater)

High-level summary (TL;DR):
- Samira onboarding broadly successful: dev laptop images, VPN, and local dev server running.
- Completed 3 onboarding tasks, pair-programmed on basic inference-run loop, and observed a live canary deploy.
- Main blockers: access to some internal test datasets (PII gating), and ambiguous README steps for model-compile flow.
- Recommended next 2 weeks: pair with Leo for infra runbook + small bugfix to shipping pipeline; 1:1 weekly mentoring with Carter; add explicit README step and a short runbook PR.

Detailed notes:
1) Access & infra setup
- Account provisioning: Ok except for "redwood-test-samples" GCS bucket access (request PR RED-1452 in Linear).
- KMS/HSM key access: requested via security ticket SEC-678; expected resolution ~3 business days. Impact: Samira cannot run full end-to-end inference tests that hit private keys — can do local model execution only.
- VPN and Jumpbox: good. Docker image build succeeded (image tag: devx/samira-2025-06-05).
- Local redis/kvcache: Samira hit an inconsistent local port mapping; Leo helped and added a note to the local dev guide.

Action items from access & infra:
- Leo: follow up on RED-1452 and add temporary synthetic dataset so Samira can continue testing (due 2025-06-12).
- Ava: escalate SEC-678 with security standby to reduce turnaround (due 2025-06-10).

2) Orientation / learning progress
- Completed: company doc walkthrough, security org intro, serving-runtime architecture primer (90m), first pairing session: simple request/response trace through the runtime (2 hours).
- Observed: canary deploy with rollback demo (Maya) — Samira asked good questions about fallbacks and routing policies.
- Missed: scheduled "profiler & perf indicators" session (postponed to week 2).

Notes to self (DX): keep the runtime intro split into two smaller sessions — 45m overview + 45m hands-on; too much content at once.

3) Pairing and early tasks
- Task A (completed): fix small doc typo and add missing example in the local dev guide (PR #68 merged).
- Task B (in progress): debug a flaky unit test in model-loader (assigned). Samira reproduced locally; root cause likely async cache init.
- Task C (proposed): add a tiny end-to-end smoke test that runs against synthetic data to validate request routing behavior.

Mentorship & pairing plan:
- Buddy pairing: Leo and Samira will pair 3x/week for 60–90 minutes during the next two weeks to onboard pipeline ownership.
- Mentoring: Carter will host a 1:1 every Tuesday (30m) focusing on career growth and context.
- Group onboarding: join the infra triage rotation shadow in week 3.

4) Interview debrief notes (context: Samira was recently converted from candidate; capturing hiring rationale for records)
- Source: on-site loop May 19–21, scored by infra panel.
- Strengths observed during interview: solid systems fundamentals, clear debugging approach, good communication with non-engineers, rapid learning on an unfamiliar stack.
- Areas to grow: deeper exposure to distributed cache consistency, more experience with security gating (KMS, HSM) — both expected to be learned on the job.
- Decision rationale: hire due to demonstrated trajectory and cultural fit; hiring manager comfortable with mentorship plan.

5) Team health pulse (qualitative)
- Samira: reports feeling welcome and not overwhelmed; enjoys hands-on tasks rather than passive reading.
- Buddy (Leo): comfortable with current load; asks for an explicit list of micro-tasks so pairing sessions are productive.
- Manager (Maya): wants better visibility into onboarding velocity (a small checklist to mark off would help).
- DX team note: prioritize making the first three deliverables low-risk and high-feedback (fast PRs).

Proposed checklist (first 30 days) — to be copy/pasted into onboarding tracker:
- [ ] Laptop + VPN + Jumpbox ✅
- [ ] Docker image build + local runtime boot ✅
- [ ] Access to test dataset or synthetic data (if gated) ⬜
- [ ] First merged PR (doc or test) ✅
- [ ] Pair-coded bugfix merged ⬜
- [ ] Smoke e2e with synthetic data merged ⬜
- [ ] Shadow triage rotation scheduled ⬜
- [ ] 30-day career conversation scheduled ⬜

Risks / blockers (priority sorted):
- Access to redwood-test-samples (blocks e2e smoke) — high priority (RED-1452).
- KMS/HSM gating (blocks tests that hit KMS) — medium priority, security ticket open.
- Sparse onboarding docs around model-compile flow — low priority but high friction; propose a 20–30 minute doc sprint to add a clear step list.

Open questions to resolve:
- Can we provide a synthetic dataset snapshot for new hires that avoids PII gating but mimics shape? (Leo to implement; answer expected 2025-06-12)
- Are we comfortable letting Samira run non-prod jobs that touch read-only test keys while HSM access is pending? (Maya to confirm with security)
- Should we formalize the buddy pairing sessions in the onboarding checklist (yes — add cadence)?

Immediate next steps (owners & due dates):
- Leo: push synthetic dataset + test harness for Samira (due 2025-06-12).
- Ava: create a lightweight 45m profiler session and schedule for week 2 (due 2025-06-11).
- Maya: confirm non-prod read-only allowance with security and update ticket SEC-678 (due 2025-06-10).
- Samira: continue Task B (unit test debugging) and open a WIP PR with description + repro steps (due 2025-06-13).

Notes for archival / hiring ledger:
- Save this doc to the hiring folder and attach to Samira's onboarding record (consolidation for future hiring retrospectives).
- Short kudos: Samira’s first PR (#68) was clean and included a test; flag for recognition in next all-hands.

Appendix: quick links (for Samira)
- Local dev guide: /confluence/devx/local-dev-guide (internal)
- Linear ticket RED-1452: redwood-inference/linear/RED-1452
- Security ticket SEC-678 (request status)
- Buddy channel: #eng-buddies (Slack)

-- end of notes --

(Notes to self: keep this doc minimal, move checklist into tracker, and convert action items into Linear tasks after meeting.)
